reviewedAcceptable.reason: Distinct backend contracts and distinct user DTO types; shared token/session conversion alone is not worth forcing a common DTO abstraction.
Presigned download and upload clients share progress and error handling. A shared helper is a separate refactor, not a silent clone of one feature into another.
The download client and ApiFailure both map Dio failures. They are not the same type and should not be merged.
Login and registration credentials are distinct value objects with parallel field checks. Combining them would hide which flow owns the fields.
Family name and given name are separate domain values with the same shape. One type would erase the distinction the API requires.
Family name and display name are different concepts that happen to validate a trimmed string the same way.
